title: Decompose lint pipeline into language plugins and add automated dependency rotation
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Refactor: Lint pipeline modularized into language plugin adapters. Feature: Automated dependency rotation service added to open and test dependency update PRs on a weekly cadence. Ops: Deprecated legacy makefile lint targets. No runtime behaviour changes expected.
description: Motivation: developer feedback and CI flakiness showed the monolithic lint runner was slowing presubmit feedback and making dependency churn risky. This PR breaks the lint pipeline into explicit language plugin adapters, introduces a small plugin contract, and adds an automated dependency-rotation scheduler to safely roll forward low-risk devdeps. Changes include a new plugin loader, language adapters for python/ts/go, a lightweight dep-rotator service that opens PRs against our repos with tests run by the existing CI lanes, and a migration path that keeps the old pipeline as a feature-flagged fallback. Checklist: [x] plugin contract and loader implemented [x] python/typescript/go adapters added [x] dep-rotator worker + scheduler added [x] migration feature flag and docs updated [x] existing CI matrix integrated with new jobs [x] release notes drafted. Why now: presubmit latency has regressed for large monorepo changes and dependency drift is causing urgent follow-ups. Design highlights: language plugins are small binaries or scripts executed under the same hermetic runner, they declare lint-target patterns and provide a normalized exitcode+report JSON. The loader picks plugins by file globs and runs them in parallel per-changed-file batches. The dep-rotator runs weekly in a lightweight k8s CronJob, clones the repo, runs the dependency bump strategy (pin-to-latest-minor, run tests, open PR with changelog and CI link), and annotates PRs for staged rollout. Rollout plan: enable plugin loader behind feature flag (default off) for two weeks, mirror CI results in a staging branch, then flip on progressively for service owners. Backout: fall back to legacy runner by disabling flag. Risk: new scheduler requires RBAC for creating PRs and a robot token; token is scoped and rotated by the secrets team. Related: builds on ENG-2417 (presubmit decomposition) and ENG-2432 (lint telemetry). Docs: added CONDUCT and docs/ci/lint-plugins.md. Testing: unit tests for plugin contract, e2e presubmit smoke on a staging branch, integration tests for dep rotation executing on a fork with dry-run mode. Known issues: initial TS adapter has one noisy rule that is being tuned, and one flaky integration test was quarantined with a linked ticket. Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2417/lint-pipeline-plugin-design, scheduler diagram https://company.internal/diagrams/dep-rotator. Merge: squashed and merged after final approval. Timeline: work started 2025-10-01, first review 2025-10-20, last review 2025-11-02. Summary of commits: 10 commits squashed into one merge commit capturing plugin loader, three adapters, dep-rotator service, CI job definitions, and docs updates.
